podcast.title: Proto-rap Foundation (1970s)
podcast.body: Afro-Jazz served as a primary musical base for the development of proto-rap in the 1970s, characterized by its combination with narrative elements where the voice typically delivered a discourse rather than marking the rhythm. "es una base de afro y jazz combinada con la narrativa que no está marcando el ritmo, simplemente está narrando, está dando un discurso."
